Try our games! ~Rank up on the leaderboards, page 6~
Water your bonsai once a day with the w key
You can open a public room with /public #room
Switch what you hear: v then x cycles audio sources, v then 1-4 picks a stream or station
Configure your notification preferences: ctrl+o
Press ? outside of chat to see help
Press tab to cycle through chat, games, and art
You can /ignore and /unignore @users
Try out blackjack, poker, and chess!!
Ctrl+G then c posts a chess960 challenge: same chess, shuffled back rank, castle by moving your king onto your own rook
Press Control+] to open the emoji and symbol picker
Press 2 for minigames, 3 for games, 4 for artboard, 5 for profiles
Type /binds in chat for a list of available chat commands
You can change your username in ctrl+o settings
Connect from an IRC client with a token from ctrl+o settings
Music is available through web streaming and CLI
You can start a DM with someone by typing /dm @username
Look for instructions on how to tune in to the music...
Type /active in chat to see who is online
Use /members to see who's in the current room
Select a chat message with j/k and press r to reply to it
Solve a daily puzzle every day to build a streak and earn chip rewards
Earn chips by solving daily puzzles and quests (page 2)
Share a web link in the special 'news' chatroom
Install and use Nerd Fonts for the best experience!
Check in on your pet with /pet feed and /pet water
Try a different color theme in ctrl+o settings
Your bonsai grows slow and steady, water it daily for the best results
The music keeps playing even when you're not chatting!
Resize your terminal and the layout reflows automatically
You land in the Clubhouse: walk with hjkl, press i to talk, w to wave, x to dance
In the Clubhouse your words float over your head; the full chat lives on Home (1)
Walk up to the Clubhouse dog and press Enter. Everyone sees the pet
Press ` on Home to hop through games waiting on you: your-move boards, seated tables, unfinished daily puzzles, live door games
Type /search in chat to find old messages across all your rooms
Made a private room? /roominfo sets what it is about and its rules
Lost in Lateania? Press m for the overhead map: it fills in only where you have walked
Defend the Gate in CodeKeep: open Games (3), select CodeKeep, and press Enter
On cyberspace.online too? Link your account and post from here: /cs link
Their chat rooms work from here as well: /cs chat, then Enter to add one to your rail
Chat in another language? Press t on a message to translate it, or set a language in ctrl+o settings
Press g on someone else's message to gild it: three tiers, chips to the author, a permanent marker on the message
/crown shows who wears the crown; /crown take buys it off them and burns every chip
Sliding Puzzle in the Arcade: press i to swap numbered tiles for the picture, same board, same chips
